item.title: Ars Linguae Web
item.author: William Guimont-Martin
item.description:
Ars Linguae is a small web application for discovering new words and committing them to memory through regular review.

Open Ars Linguae

item.title: Nelligan Web
item.author: William Guimont-Martin
item.description:
Nelligan is a small web application for memorizing poetry. It helps you progressively hide parts of a poem, recall them from memory, and repeat the process until you can recite the complete text.

Open Nelligan
